# Bright Plum, Inc.

> Bright Plum is the proactive web operations partner for higher education. We provide ongoing Drupal and WordPress support — security, accessibility, performance, and platform stability — for the small marketing and communications teams at colleges and universities that need their sites to stay stable, compliant, and in control without adding headcount. We're an SBA 8(a)-certified, NMSDC minority-owned business enterprise (MBE) with 15+ years in the open-source, complex-publishing space.

## How it works

Every engagement begins with a fixed-scope, fixed-price Website Risk Sprint that scores your site across six dimensions — security, accessibility, performance, platform health, documentation, and communication — and produces a prioritized roadmap you keep whether or not you continue with us. Ongoing support then runs on one of three plans, all built on a documented playbook and a dedicated account manager.

- [How It Works — the Website Risk Sprint & Web Operations Radar](https://brightplum.com/how-it-works)
- [Support Plans — Foundation, Standard, Strategic](https://brightplum.com/how-it-works#tiers)

## Proof

- [Case Studies](https://brightplum.com/case-studies): higher-ed and nonprofit teams that turned inherited, at-risk sites into stable platforms
- [The Sjögren's Foundation](https://brightplum.com/case-studies/sjogrens-foundation): stabilized the platform, automated operations, reclaimed 10+ staff hours a week
- [American Hospital Association](https://brightplum.com/case-studies/american-hospital-association): rebranded the Coding Clinic Advisor site with real editorial control
